content.value_statement: UnoCSS projects often need precise preset, rule, and transformer configuration. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused guidance from UnoCSS references.
actual_capabilities: Explain UnoCSS configuration options, including rules, shortcuts, theme values, safelist, and blocklist settings.
Guide setup for Vite and Nuxt projects using documented UnoCSS integration patterns.
Help design custom utility rules, dynamic shortcuts, variants, preflights, and CSS layers.
Describe presets for Wind, Mini, Icons, Attributify, Typography, Web Fonts, Tagify, and Rem to Px.
Clarify transformer behavior for variant groups, directives, compile class, and attributify JSX.
limitations: It provides documentation guidance and does not run UnoCSS or validate generated CSS.
It reflects UnoCSS 66.x references generated on 2026-01-28.
It cannot know project-specific presets unless the agent reads the local UnoCSS config.
It does not replace security review for user-authored dynamic rules or HTML templates.

use_cases.title: Configure a Frontend Build
use_cases.description: Set up UnoCSS in Vite or Nuxt with the right presets, transformers, and configuration file shape.

use_cases.title: Design Utility Systems
use_cases.description: Create custom rules, shortcuts, themes, and safelists that match an application design language.

use_cases.title: Migrate Tailwind Usage
use_cases.description: Translate common Tailwind patterns into UnoCSS presets while preserving class-based workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Config
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new project
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a basic UnoCSS setup for my Vite app. Explain which presets and imports I need.

prompt_templates.title: Add Custom Utilities
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my UnoCSS rules and shortcuts. Suggest cleaner dynamic rules for spacing, badges, and buttons.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Presets and Transformers
prompt_templates.prompt: I use Nuxt with JSX components. Recommend the UnoCSS presets and transformers I should enable and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Advanced Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my UnoCSS configuration for layers, preflights, safelist usage, icon loading, and theme consistency.

output_examples.input: I need UnoCSS in a Vite project with icons and Tailwind-like utilities.
output_examples.output: A concise setup plan covering the Vite plugin, Wind preset, Icons preset, and where to place configuration.

output_examples.input: My dynamic shortcut should use theme colors safely.
output_examples.output: A review explaining theme lookup, valid color checks, shortcut naming, and safer fallback behavior.

output_examples.input: I want to use @apply and grouped variants in component styles.
output_examples.output: Guidance on the directives and variant group transformers, including when each transformer should run.

best_practices: Check the project UnoCSS config before suggesting presets, shortcuts, or attributify syntax.
Prefer documented presets before adding custom rules for common Tailwind-compatible utilities.
Keep dynamic rules deterministic and validate captured values before generating CSS.
anti_patterns: Do not assume attributify mode is enabled when the project only uses class attributes.
Do not mix breakpoint units unless the configuration converts them consistently.
Do not add broad safelists when a smaller explicit list covers the needed utilities.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps agents answer UnoCSS configuration, preset, utility, shortcut, and integration questions.

faq.question: Does it generate working project files?
faq.answer: It can suggest file contents, but it does not run UnoCSS or verify builds by itself.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it cover Tailwind-compatible usage?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Wind presets and common Tailwind-style utility guidance.

faq.question: Does it support framework integrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Vite and Nuxt integration guidance, plus framework notes for common frontend stacks.

faq.question: What should users provide for best results?
faq.answer: Users should share their UnoCSS config, framework, enabled presets, and the utility behavior they want.
